name: Control — small caps that were never suspended, the arm that turns 61,6% from descriptive into discriminative
notes: Task 10. Closes the last hole left by the feasibility pass (riset/temuan-kelayakan.md
§Q1 'Peringatan: perbandingan ini masih tercampur'): the suspended basket was compared
against blue chips, which confounds size with manipulation. Small stocks have concentrated
brokers whether or not they are being pumped.
Symbols are the first ten of `universe.control_group()` — members of the 200-smallest
screener page with zero suspension events on record, across all nine reason classes and
all years, not just cooling_down since 2025. Every one already came back inside the paid
screener row set, so none of them can 404 at 1 credit.
`start` and `end` are explicit and identical to the window the suspended basket landed on
the last 30 calendar days, so a defaulted call one day later would silently shift the window
and make the two arms non-comparable.
Broker-summary for this arm is deliberately NOT bought here (20 more credits). Momentum is
tested first; if momentum alone already separates the arms, concentration need not be paid for.
